EC2: Dialysis [AND] for acute renal failure within the 6 previous months.

EC4: Urinary albumin/creatinine ratio higher than 3000 mg/g, at the baseline visit.
EC5: Systolic blood pressure [OR] = 180 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure = 110 mm Hg at the baseline visit.
